chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Called by Lunceford while John Hammond wanted him at NBC
summary: A wire reached McRae to replace Joe Thomas for two months in Akron, though Hammond had offered an NBC staff job.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing in Lionel Hampton's big band

Shoebrush?

He came downtown and he says, "I got a telegram for Jimmie Lunceford. He wants you to join him in Akron, Ohio." Say, "Joe Thomas want to take a vacation." So, I called him up, I found his home.
